title: BSE Master's Degrees (2027-2028 intake)
about: The Barcelona School of Economics accepts applications to its master's programmes starting September 2027. Applicants who submit a complete application before 15 January 2027 are considered for all funding opportunities and receive a decision by mid-February.
requirements: Funding awarded on merit; BSE assesses eligibility for tuition waivers automatically
Later applicants are considered for any remaining funding
